culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Hatsuho Toba. She killed Akaza by applying the poison on the back of her spoon when trying the cheese so the poison would get on all but the section of cheese that she tasted. Then she switched out the spoon when she wiped away the dropped cheese on Jisaburou's clothing. She stabbed Moyono Mibu (who previously tried to kill Jisaburou to inherit his fortune) with an iron skewer when her guard was down. She proceeded to stab Jisaburou with two iron skewers connected together to make the wound look like a chisel. She wrote the letter to Mouri so he could prove her innocence. Hatsuh

motive.zhHans: Hatsuho 愤愤地供认，她恨 Moyono——她以 Jisaburou 情人的身份过着奢华日子，而自己和母亲却要受苦；恨 Akaza——他试图引诱她；也恨 Jisaburou 本人——他暗中变卖她父亲的能面，连同整座博物馆一起卖掉。
motive.en: Hatsuho annoyingly confesses that she loathes Moyono for living in luxury as Jisaburou's lover while she has her mother had to suffer, Akaza for his attempts to seduce her, and Jisaburou himself for secretly selling her father's Noh Masks, as well as the entire museum itself.
motive.replacedEn: She stabbed Moyono Mibu (who previously tried to kill Jisaburou to inherit his fortune) with an iron skewer when her guard was down. Nevertheless, she failed to finish off Jisaburou due to Conan indirectly telling him to protect himself from stab wound just in case.
motive.translationNote: 按 DCW 原文原句重新指派（原值系切块错位，旧值存于 replacedEn）

method.zhHans: 她在品尝奶酪时把毒药涂在勺子背面，这样除了自己尝过的那一小块，奶酪的其余部分都会沾上毒。接着她在擦去 Jisaburou 衣服上掉落的奶酪时，趁机把勺子换掉。她趁 Moyono Mibu（此前曾想杀死 Jisaburou 以继承他的财产）不备，用一根铁签刺杀了她。随后她把两根铁签接在一起刺向 Jisaburou，好让伤口看起来像是凿子造成的。然而，由于柯南间接提醒了他以防万一、让他提防刺伤，她最终没能杀死 Jisaburou。

She proceeded to stab Jisaburou with two iron skewers connected together to make the wound look like a chisel. Nevertheless, she failed to finish off Jisaburou due to Conan indirectly telling him to protect himself from stab wound just in case.

She killed Akaza by applying the poison on the back of her spoon when trying the cheese so the poison would get on all but the section of cheese that she tasted. Then she switched out the spoon when she wiped away the dropped cheese on Jisaburou's clothing. She stabbed Moyono Mibu (who previously tried to kill Jisaburou to inherit his fortune) with an iron skewer when her guard was down. She proceeded to stab Jisaburou with two iron skewers connected together to make the wound look like a chisel. She wrote the letter to Mouri so he could prove her innocence. Hatsuho annoyingly confesses that she loathes Moyono for living in luxury as Jisaburou's lover while she has her mother had to suffer, Akaza for his attempts to seduce her, and Jisaburou himself for secretly selling her father's Noh Masks, as well as the entire museum itself. Nevertheless, she failed to finish off Jisaburou due to Conan indirectly telling him to protect himself from stab wound just in case.
